article.title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet

harvestedTerms.summary: Allen AI's OlmoEarth v1.3 release introduces a satellite foundation model that generates pre-computed 128-dimensional embeddings for every 10-meter pixel on Earth across nine years of imagery. The article describes the technical architecture (vision transformer + attention pooler), evaluation against competing models, a new tropical crop benchmark (PLANTEUR), and an interactive browser-based explorer tool. The subject matter is geospatial/remote sensing AI — only tangentially related to the AI terminology graph's core concerns around agents, LLMs, and enterprise AI.

article.title: Meta’s AI could still scrape news sites, legal experts say

harvestedTerms.summary: Meta updated its business account terms to remove explicit 'training' language after publisher backlash, but legal experts say the revised language ('develop,' 'business product') is still broad enough to permit AI training on scraped news sites. The article hinges on the robots.txt file's legal standing and whether commercial terms can supersede it.
